title: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
1.
Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sind
Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972.
(2) It shall come into force on such date as may be
notified by Government in the official Gazette.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
2.
Definitions.‑In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires,
the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned
to them, that :s to say‑
(a) "Audit Officer" means the Audit Officer of a
Board ;
(b) "Board" means a Board of Intermediate and
Secondary Education constituted under section 3 ;
(c) "Chairman" means the Chairman of a Board.
(d) "College" means an institution within the
jurisdiction of a Board and recognized by it for Intermediate education and
includes a college, having Intermediate and degree classes and affiliated to
the University for the degree classes
(e) "Committee" means a committee constituted
under this Ordinance
( f )
"Controller of Examinations" means the Controller of Examinations of
a Board 1
(g)
"Controlling Authority" means the Controlling Authority of a Board
(h)
"Government" means the Government of Sind ;
(i)
"Headmaster" and "Headmistress" mean respectively head of a
Secondary
School
(j )
"Head of an Institution" means the Principal of a College or the
Headmaster or Headmistress of a School
(k)
"Institution" means a School or a College and any other institution
recognized
as such by the Board ;
(1)
"Intermediate College" means an institution recognized for imparting
instructions to class XI and class XII and includes an institution having
classes for Intermediate and Secondary Education.
(m)
"Intermediate education" means education pertaining to class XI
and
class XII ;
(n)
"prescribed" means prescribed by Regulations or Rules
(o)
"Principal" means the head of a college ;
(p)
"recognized" means recognized by a Board ;
(q)
"Regulations" and "Rules" means respectively the
Regulations and
Rules
made under this Ordinance and for the time being in force;
(t)
"School" means an institution recognized only for the Secondary
Education
(s)
"Secondary Education" means education pertaining to Class X and
such
other classes as may be declared by Government to be classes, of Secondary
Education;
(t)
"Secretary" means the Secretary of a Board;
(u)
"University" when used with reference to Boards in Karachi means
University of Karachi and when used with reference to Boards at Hyderabad and
Khairpur means University of Sind.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Ceasure of jurisdiction

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
3.
Ceasure of jurisdiction.‑(1) As from the date of commencement of this
Ordinance, the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad
and the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi established and
reconstituted respectively under the Board of Intermediate and Secondary
Education, Hyderabad Ordinance, 1961 (West
Pakistan Ordinance XVII of 1961) and the Board of
Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi Ordinance, 1962 (West Pakistan
Ordinance III of 1962), shall cease to exercise any powers and perform any
functions;
Establishment and incorporation.‑‑And as from
the said date shall be reconstituted and established‑
(i)
at Khairpur a Board called the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education,
Khairpur;
(ii)
at Hyderabad a Board called the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education,
Hyderabad; and
(iii)
in Karachi two Boards one called Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
Saddar, Karachi and other called Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
Nazimabad; Karachi.
(2) A
Board shall be a body corporate and shall have perpetual succes sion and a
common seal with power to acquire and hold property and to transfer the same, and
may sue or be sued by the corporate name.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Constitution  of the board

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
4. Constitution of the Board.‑(1) A
Board shall consist of the following members, namely:‑
(i) the Chairman;
(li) the Vice‑Chanceller of the University or a
University Professor nominated by him;
(iii) the Director of Education, Sind, for the Boards at
Hyderabad and Khairpur and the Director of Education, Karachi for Boards in
Karachi;
(iv) one expert on technical education to be nominated by
the Control ling Authority;
(v) one representative of the Syndicate of the University;
(vi) one Principal of a College nominated by the
Controlling Authority;
(vii) one representative of Heads of Intermediate Colleges
elected by and from among themselves;
(viii)
one Headmaster or Headmistress of Schools elected by and from among the
Headmasters and Headmistresses of Schools; and
(Ix)
two persons nominated by the Controlling Authority.
(2)
The names of the nominated and elected members shall be notified in the
official Gazette.
(3)
The term of office of members other than ex‑officio members shall be two
years.
(4)
No member appointed by virtue of his office shall continue to be a member if he
ceases to hold that office.
(5)
When a person ceases to be a member of a Board he shall cease to be a member of
any of the Committees of which he may be a member.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Resignation of members

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
5.
Resignation of members.‑A member of a Board may resign his membership by
a letter addressed to the Chairman ; provided that the resignation shall
not have effect until it is accepted by the Controlling Authority.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Removal of members

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
6.
Removal of members.‑A member of a Board shall be liable to be removed by
the Controlling Authority, if‑
(i) he becomes of unsound mind,
(ii) he is declared insolvent by a competent Court;
(iii) he is convicted by a Criminal Court of an offence
involving moral turpitude.
The decision of the Controlling Authority in this behalf
shall be final.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Casual vacancies

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
7.
Casual vacancies.‑‑(1) Whenever there occurs a vacancy in the
membership of a Board due to death, resignation or removal, it shall be filled
In accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance.
(2) The person who fills the vacancy shall be a member of
the Board for the remaining term only.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Meeting of the board

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
8.
Meeting of the Board.‑(1) The. Chairman may, whenever he considers
necessary and shall, on a requisition from at least five members of the
Board, call a meeting of the Board.
(2) The quorum for meetings of a Board shall be six.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Jurisdiction of the board

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
9.
Jurisdiction of the Board.‑(1) A Board shall exercise the powers
conferred on it by or under this Ordinance in respect of the institutions
within the territorial limits that may be notified by Government in the
official Gazette.
(2) Government may, by general or special order, modify
the jurisdic tion of a Board with regard to such territorial limits or
institutions.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Intermediate examination in agriculture

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
10.
Intermediate Examination in Agriculture.‑The Intermediate Examination in Agriculture
shall continue to be conducted by the University.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Powers of a board

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
11.
Powers of a Board.‑(I) Subject to the provisions of this Ordinance a
Board shall have power to organize, regulate, develop and control Intermediate
Education and Secondary Education.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the generality
of the power conferred by the preceding subsection, a Board shall have the
power‑‑
(i) to hold and conduct all examinations pertaining to
Intermediate Education and Secondary Education and such other examinations as
may be determined by Government ;
(ii) to prescribe courses of study for its examinations ;
(iii) to lay down conditions for recognition of
institutions ;
(iv) to accord, refuse or withdraw recognition wholly or
partly, after considering inspection reports‑
(a)
in the case of Schools, received from the Education Department, Government of
Sind ; and
(B)
in the case of Intermediate Colleges, received from an Inspection Committee
appointed by the Board in this behalf ;
(v)
to inspect and arrange for inspection of recognized institutions and call for
inspection reports ;
(vi)
to lay down conditions for admission to its examinations, to determine the
eligibility of candidates and ,to admit them to the examinations ;
(vii)
to grant certificates and diplomas to persons who have pasted its examinations
and to withdraw such' certificates and diplomas ;
(viii)
to fix, demand and receive such fees as may be prescribed ;
(ix)
to supervise the residence, health and discipline of the students of recognized
institutions and classes with a view to promoting their general
welfare
;
(x)
to institute and award scholarships. medals and prizes in accordance with the
Regulations and Rules ;
(xi)
to organize and promote extra‑moral activities in and for recognized
institutions
;
(xii)
to hold, control and administer its property and funds ;
Wit)
to enter into and carry out contracts in exercise of its powers and performance
of its duties under this Ordinance and the Regulations ;
(xiv)
to pass the annual budget ;
(xv)
to transfer any movable and immovable property ;
(xvi)
to hold and manage endowments ;
(xvii)
to regulate and decide all administrative matters, including the creation and
abolition of posts 1 provided that it shall be lawful for the Chairman to
create temporary poses for a period not exceeding six months ;
(xviii)
to appoint the staff and define their duties and conditions of service in
accordance with the Government rules ;
(xix)
to make provision for building, premises, furniture, apparatus, books and other
means required for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance ;
(xx)
to sanction such expenditure and to appoint such officers and staff as may be
necessary to carry out the purposes of this Ordinance ; and
(xxi)
to do all other acts necessary for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
(3) A
Board may delegate any of its powers to its Chairman or any officer of the
Board or to a Sub‑Committee appointed by it as it may deem fit.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Controlling authority

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
12.
Controlling Authority.‑The Governor of Sind or his nominee shall be the
Controlling Authority of a Board.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Powers of the controlling authority

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
13.
Powers of the Controlling Authority.‑The Controlling Authority shall have
the power to cause an inspection to be made by such person or persons as he may
direct, of the offices, activities and funds of, and examinations
conducted by, a Board, and to cause an inquiry to be made in like manner in
respect of any matter concerning a Board.
(2) The Controlling Authority shall communicate to the
Board the result of such inspection or enquiry and may advise the Board to take
such action within such period as may be specified.
(3) The Board shall report to the Controlling Authority
the action it proposes to take or has taken on such communication.
(4) Where the Board does not, within a reasonable time,
take action to the satisfaction of the Controlling Authority, the Controlling
Authority, may, after considering any explanation made by the Board issue such
directions as it thinks fit, and the Chairman shall comply with such
directions.
(5)
If the Controlling Authority is satisfied that any proceeding of a Board or a
Committee is not in conformity with this Ordinance, the Control ling Authority,
may, without prejudice to the foregoing provisions of this section, by order In
writing, annul such proceeding:
Provided
that before making any such order the Controlling Authority shall, through the
Chairman, call upon the Board or the Committee, as the case may be, to show
cause why such an order should not be made.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Officers of the board

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
14.
Officers of the Board.‑(1) The following shall be the officers of a Board‑
.
(i)
the Chairman;
(ii) the Secretary;
(iii) the Controller of Examinations;
(iv) the Audit Officer; and
(v) such other officers as maybe appointed by the Board.
(2) The Chairman, the Secretary, the Controller of
Examinations and the Audit Officer shall be whole‑time officers and shall
be appointed by the Controlling Authority on such terms and conditions as may
be determined by it.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Chairman

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
15.
Chairman.‑(1) The Chairman shall hold office for a term of three years
from the date of notification of his appointment and on the expiry of the term
of office shall be eligible for re‑appointment for such further
period as may be specified in the order of appointment.
(2) When the office of the Chairman is vacant temporarily
or otherwise, by reason of leave, illness or other cause, for a period not
exceeding one year, the Controlling Authority shall make such arrangements for
carrying on the duties of the office of the Chairman a3 it may think fit.
(3) The Chairman shall be the principal executive and
academic officer of the Board and shall, when present, preside at the meetings
of
(i) the Board;
(ti)
the Committees of a Board constituted under the Regulations.
(4)
It shall be the duty of the Chairman to ensure that the provisions of this
Ordinance and the Regulations and Rules are faithfully observed and carried out,
and he shall exercise all powers necessary for this purpose.
(5)
In any emergency arising out of the administrative business of the Board and
requiring, in the opinion of the Chairman, immediate action, the Chairman may
take such action as he may deem necessary and shall report the action so taken
to the Board at its next meeting for approval.
(6)
The Chairman shall exercise such other powers as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Other officers

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
16.
Other Officers.‑Subject to the provisions of this Ordinance the powers
and duties of other officers of the Board shall be such as may be determined by
the Board.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Powers of the board to make regulations

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
17.
Powers of the Board to make Regulations.‑(1) A Board shall have the power
to make Regulations consistent with this Ordinance on all or any of the
following matters, namely t‑
(a) the constitution, powers and duties of Committees ;
(b) additional powers and duties of the officers of the
Board mentioned In section 14 ;
(c) rules of service including rules regulating
disciplinary action, grant of leave and retirement of the employees of the
Board ;
(d) constitution of pension or Provident Fund or both for
the benefit of the officers and other employees of the Board ;
(e) admission of institutions to the privilege of
recognition and with drawal of recognition ;
(f )
general scheme of studies, including the total number of subjects to be taught
and the duration of courses ; and
(g)
such other matters as may appear necessary for giving effect to the provisions
of this Ordinance.
(2)
The Regulations approved by the Board shall be submitted to Government and
shall not take effect until they are approved by Govern ment. Government may
approve or disallow or remit them to the Board with its recommendations for
further consideration.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Powers of the board to make rules

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
18.
Powers of the Board to make Rules.‑A Board may make ules consistent with
this Ordinance and the Regulations to provide for‑
(i) inspection of institutions and the reports, returns
and other informa tion to be furnished by them ;
(it) conditions of admission of candidates to the
examinations and eligibility for diplomas, certificates and titles ; and
(iii) such other matters as may be required to be
prescribed by Rules in the Regulations.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Funds

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
19.
Funds.‑A Board shall have a fund to which shall be credited all its
income including income from fees, endowments, grants and contributions.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Accounts and audits

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
20.
Accounts and Audits.‑(1) The accounts of a Board shall be maintained in
such manner as may be prescribed by Rules.
(2) The statement of accounts of a Board shall be
submitted to Government once a year.
(3) The accounts of the Board shall be audited in such
manner as may be prescribed by the Regulations.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Provident fund or pension

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
21.
Provident Fund or Pension.‑(1) A Board shall establish for the benefit of
its employees such pension or Provident Fund or both as it may deem fit in such
manner and subject to such conditions as may be prescribed.
(2) Government may, by notification, declare that the
provisions of the Provident Fund Act, 1925, shall apply to such fund, and on
the making of such declaration that Act shall apply accordingly as if such
Board were Government and the said fund were the Government Provident Fund.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Members prohibited from driving monetary gains

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
22.
Members prohibited from driving monetary gains.‑No member of a Board
shall draw any fee or other remuneration in any capacity what ever from the
funds of the Board or enter into any contract with the Board directly or
through any other person in connection with the affairs of the Board t
Provided that the emoluments of the Chairman shall in
accordance with the terms and conditions of his appointment, be paid from the
funds of the Board t
Provided further that a member of a Committee may receive
from the Board remuneration in lump‑sum for writing, compiling or editing
a book Intended to be prescribed for an examination of the Board.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Bar against membership

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
23.
Bar against membership.‑No person who has any financial interest in any
book prescribed by a Board as a course of study for any examination conducted
by such Board or has a financial interest as a partner or other wiser in
any firm which publishes, procures, or sppplips any such book: shall
be eligible to become a member of such Board or a
Committee thereof or continue as such after having acquired any such interest.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Validation

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
24.
Validation.‑No act or proceedings of a Board or any Committee shall be invalidated_merely
by reason of the existence of a vacancy on the Board or the Committee, as the
case may be, or by reason of any irregularity in the appointment of any member
of the Board or the Committee.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Bar to suits

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
25. Bar to suits.‑No acts done, orders
passed or proceedings taken by a Board shall be called in question in
any Court by a suit or otherrvise.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Members and employees to be public servants

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
26.
Members and employees to be public servants.‑Members of the Board and the
Committee constituted under this Ordinance, the employees of the Board and
other persons appointed for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance,
shall be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of section 21 of the
Pakistan Penal Code.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Protection of acts and orders

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
27.
Protection of acts and orders.‑No suit for damages or other legal
proceedings shall be instituted against Government, the Controlling Authority,
the Board, any Committee, any member of the Board of Committee, or
officer or employee of the Board in respect of anything done or purported to
have been done in good faith in pursuance of this Ordinance and the Regulations
and Rules made thereunder.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
First regulations

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
28.
First Regulations.‑(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained
in this Ordinance, the Regulations set out in the Schedule shall, on the
commencement of this Ordinance, be deemed to be the First Regulations framed by
the Board under section 17.
(2) The Regulations laid down by Government within three
months of the date of commencement of this Ordinance shall become part of the
Schedule.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Transitional provisions

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
29.
Transitional provisions.‑‑(1) From the date of commencement of this
Ordinance and till such time as the nominated and elected members are
appointed, the Chairman and the ex‑officio members shall exercise
all the powers and perform all the duties of the Board and its Committees.
(2) On the appointment of the nominated and elected
members, the Board shall exercise all powers and perform all duties of the
Committees of the Board till such Committees are constituted.
(3) If any difficulty arises in giving effect to the
provisions of this Ordinance, the Controlling Authority may take such action to
remove the difficulty as it may deem necessary.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Savings

ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
30.
Savings.‑(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this
Ordinance and the Regulations made thereunder, everything done. action
taken, obligation or liability incurred, rights and assets acquired, person
appointed or authorised, jurisdiction or power conferred, endow ment, bequest
or fund created, donation and grant made, scholarship or award instituted,
recognition granted and order issued under
any of the provisions of the Board of Intermediate and
Secondary Education, Hyderabad Ordinance, 1961 (West Pakistan Ordinance XVII of
1961) and the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Karachi Ordinance,
1962 (West Pakistan Ordinance III of 1962) and the regulations and rules made
thereunder, shall he continued and so far as may be, be deemed to have been
respectively done, taken, incurred, acquired, appointed or
authorised,
conferred, created, made. instituted, granted and issued under this Ordinance
or the Regulations made thereunder.
(2)
The Board shall have the power to decide whether any regulation or rule framed
under the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Hyderabad Ordinance,
1961 (West Pakistan Ordinance XVII of 1961), and the Board of Intermediate and
Secondary Education, Karachi Ordinance, 1962 (West Pakistan Ordinance III of
1962), is or is not consistent with the provisions of this Ordinance and the
Regulations and Rules made there under.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
ORDINANCE VI OF 1972
ORDINANCE
VI OF 1972
SINDH
BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1972
SCHEDULE
The First Regulations of the Board 1. Powers and duties of the Chairman.‑The
Chairman shall exercise
control over the office of the Board as its principal
executive and academic officer and shall do all acts to ensure that the
officers and the staff properly perform the duties entrusted to them. In
particular he shall‑
(i) write confidential reports on the work of officers
whose grades carry an initial salary of three hundred rupees or more per mensem
;
(ii) recommend to the Board any disciplinary action that
he considers necessary against officers mentioned in clause (i) ;
(iii)
take disciplinary action against members of the establishment whose grades carry
an initial salary of less than three hundred rupees per mensem ; and
(iv)
appoint Superintendents of Examination.
2.
Powers and duties of the Secretary.‑(I) The Secretary shall, subject
to
the control of the Chairman, be incharge of the academic and adminis trative
sector of the Board's office and shall cause the orders and decisions of the
Board and the Chairman to be carried out.
(2)
The Secretary shall take all possible steps to ensure that the funds
of
the Board are spent on the purpose for which they are provided.
(3)
The Secretary shall cause to be prepared and submit to the Board for approval
the annual statement of accounts and budget estimates.
(4)
All meetings of the Board and the Committees shall be convened try the
Secretary under the directions of the Chairman. While preparing the agenda for
a meeting of the Board or a Committee, the Secretary shall carry out the
directions of the Chairman given in this respect and no item shall be placed on
agenda or be considered in the meeting without previous permission of the

(5)
The Secretary shall record the minutes and maintain the records of the
proceedings of the Board and the Committees.
(6)
The Secretary shall conduct the official correspondence of the Board under the
authority of the Chairman except the correspondence relating to the conduct of
examinations.
(7)
All fees and dues payable to the Board, and all sums received by the Secretary,
shall be credited without delay to the account of the Board In a Bank or
treasury approved by the Board.
(8)
The Secretary shall issue to successful candidates on behalf of the Board, in
the prescribed form, certificates of having passed the examinations held by the
Board.
(9)
The Secretary shall perform such other duties as may be assigned, to him by the
Chairman.
(10)
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in these Regulations the Board may
assign to any other officer or officers such duties of the Secretary as it may
deem necessary.
(11)
The post of the Secretary shall be a tenure post. The term of his appointment
shall be three years and may be renewed.
